ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio with extreme dominance of low-intensity (black) pixels across the fluke surface (>90%) relative to localized high-intensity (white) pixels at scar and barnacle sites.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous low-intensity dark field across both lobes; high-contrast white geometric blobs are mapped as discrete circular rings (rosettes) in medial regions and irregular dense clusters at distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression at the central axis with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations; the right lobe trailing edge contains five distinct jagged peaks, while the left lobe exhibits four shallower, more rounded topographic variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward and outward curvature extending from the central median notch to the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular white ring clusters; notable triplet overlapping constellation on the upper distal right lobe and scattered individual rosettes on the medial left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible near the central peduncle base, extending toward the medial lower regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; widespread white circular depigmentation scars (rosettes) across the fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The distal tips of the fluke are heavily modified by biological growth (barnacle clusters), creating irregular, bulbous 3D protrusions that break the linear contour of the lobe edges.
